entity.name: Guy Bary
entity.description:
I'm Guy Bary, creator and sole maintainer of Octocode, an MIT-licensed code research platform for AI agents and developers. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bgauryy

Note: I'm using an AI assistant to help me with outreach and drafting. I review everything that goes out under my name.

projects.name: Octocode
projects.description: Octocode is an MIT-licensed code research platform for AI agents and developers. Available as an MCP server and CLI backed by a Rust engine, it researches local code, GitHub and npm with exact, citable context and fewer tokens. The main package gets about 5,000 npm downloads a week.

plans.name: Full-time maintenance and the next major release
plans.description: Sustains solo maintenance of Octocode (about 5,000 weekly npm downloads of the main package): releases, issue and PR triage, and the token cost of AI-assisted review, testing and benchmarking.
